watches.name: Mission Series 01 – VH31 Seiko Meca Quartz – In stock
watches.description: Built for adventure and designed to perform wherever the journey takes you, the all-new Mission Series 01 is a rugged, purpose-driven watch made to handle the demands of the outdoors without sacrificing style. Now Offering DDP – Delivered Duty Prepaid to the U.S & Europe The durable 316L bead-blasted stainless steel case gives the watch a refined matte finish while helping reduce the appearance of everyday scratches and wear. A brushed ceramic bezel, signed screw-down crown, and 200 metres of water resistance provide the strength and reliability needed for hiking, travel, water activities, and everyday exploration. At the heart of the Mission Series 01 is the Seiko VH31 Meca-Quartz movement. Unlike a traditional quartz movement that advances once per second, the VH31 moves four times per second, creating a noticeably smoother, sweeping seconds hand while maintaining the accuracy, durability, and convenience of quartz. Tough, dependable, and ready for anything, the Mission Series 01 is built to withstand the rugged outdoors and whatever you choose to throw at it. watches.name: Skyline – JP21 Miyota Quartz
watches.description: Inspired by the legendary Skyline GT-R, the all-new Skyline brings the unmistakable character of an automotive icon to the wrist. Every detail has been designed to reflect the car’s distinctive cockpit and rear profile, creating a watch that feels both familiar and completely original. Now Offering DDP – Delivered Duty Prepaid to the U.S & Europe The Skyline is powered by the reliable Miyota JP21 quartz movement, offering accurate and dependable timekeeping rated to +/- 20 seconds per month. The dial features complications rarely seen in a watch of this style. The date window is designed to resemble the Skyline’s gauge cluster, while the two circular sub-dials take inspiration from its iconic round tail lights. These sub-dial display the day of the week and a 24-hour indicator, combining distinctive automotive design with practical everyday functionality. The Skyline is more than a tribute—it is a carefully designed timepiece created for automotive enthusiasts and watch collectors who appreciate performance, detail and unmistakable design.
